curiosityReview.storyRoute: Inverted car and brief hop → two systems → pressure removal → outside air/gravity → separate gas release → movement/rotation → finite storage and flight distinction.

truthBoundary.rationale: Explain how the attributed systems work; no claim to independently validate stunt configuration, measured performance or practical flight.
